title: [YSQL] Postmaster can PANIC when multiple processes are killed simultaneously and one holds a spinlock
body:
Jira Link: [DB-17481](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-17481)
### Description

There are two cases that were not previously handled. 
## (A): A process is killed while holding the lock, and then another process is killed

| P1                | P2                                | Postmaster                                                                                                                                       | Who owns ProcStructLock? |
|------------------|------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|
| Start P1         |                                    |                                                                                                                                                  |                           |
| P1 acquires ProcStructLock |                          |                                                                                                                                                  | P1                        |
| P1 releases ProcStructLock |                          |                                                                                                                                                  | P1                        |
| P1 is started     |                                    |                                                                                                                                                  |                           |
|                  | Start P2                           |                                                                                                                                                  |                           |
|                  | P2 acquires ProcStructLock         |                                                                                                                                                  | P2                        |
|                  | //**KILL -9**//                          | Signal handler invokes `reaper` to clean up after P2. It sets `YbCrashInUnmanageableState` to true because it cannot find a proc struct for this backend. | P2                        |
| //**KILL -9**//         |                                    |                                                                                                                                                  | P2                        |
|                  |                                    | Signal handler invokes `reaper` to clean up after P1. It tries to acquire ProcStructLock                                                          | P2                        |
|                  |                                    | //Waiting on lock//                                                                                                                                | P2                        |
|                  |                                    | The P1 cleanup is still waiting on the lock, and fatals with *stuck spinlock detected*                                                           | P2                        |

In summary: P2 is killed while holding the lock. The postmaster now knows it needs to restart all backends. Then P1 is killed. It is a normal-looking termination, so the postmaster attempts to cleanup after it, but fails to acquire the lock. 

## (B): A process is killed while another process holds the lock, and then that process is killed

| P1                     | P2                             | Postmaster                                                                                                      | Who owns ProcStructLock? |
|------------------------|--------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|
| Start P1               |                                |                                                                                                                 |                           |
| P1 acquires ProcStructLock |                          |                                                                                                                 | P1                        |
| P1 releases ProcStructLock |                          |                                                                                                                 | P1                        |
| P1 is started          |                                |                                                                                                                 |                           |
|                        | Start P2                       |                                                                                                                 |                           |
|                        | P2 acquires ProcStructLock     |                                                                                                                 | P2                        |
| //**KILL -9**//              |                                | Signal handler invokes `reaper` to clean up after P1 by acquiring ProcStructLock. It waits on the lock         | P2                        |
|                        | //**KILL -9**//                      | //Waiting on lock//                                                                                               | P2                        |
|                        |                                | The P1 cleanup is still waiting on the lock, and fatals with **stuck spinlock detected**                          | P2                        |

In summary: P1 is started and running normally. While P2 is starting and owns the ProcStructLock, P1 is killed then P2 is killed. The postmaster tries to cleanup after P1 but the spinlock is still owned by the dead P2. 

This is a trickier problem: When P1 is killed and cleanup starts, the lock is held legitamately by P2. P2 only dies after the postmaster is already waiting on the lock to clean up after P1.
